Whether it's to animate events, create specific promotions or build customer loyalty, there are plenty of opportunities in 2023!

Check out our marketing calendar of restaurant chestnuts and don't miss any important dates!

‍

January 2023

January 1: New Year's Day (holiday), Dry January (month in alcohol)

January 6: Epiphany (Galette des rois) 

January 14-15: Truffle Festival 

January 16: Spicy Food Day, Blue Monday, Australian Open (Tennis)

January 17: International Day of Italian Cuisine 🍝

January 19: International Popcorn Day 🍿

January 21: Cuddle Day

January 22: Chinese New Year 🥡

January 28-29: Feast of Saint Vincent Tournante, patron saint of winegrowers

‍

February 2023

February 2: Candlemas 🥞

February 3: International No Straw Day

February 4: Kick-off of the 6 Nations Tournament (rugby) 

February 5: World Nutella Day

February 7: World No Mobile Phone Day

February 9: Pizza Day 🍕

February 10: International Legume Day 🥬

February 14: Valentine's Day 

February 21: Mardi Gras

February 24: International Bartenders' Day, International "I hate cilantro" Day

February 25: Agricultural Show

February 26: International Pistachio Day

February 28: World No Facebook Day

‍

March 2023

March 1: World Compliments Day

March 3: World Obesity Day

March 5: Grandmother's Day

March 8: International Women's Day

March 11: World Plumbing Day

March 14: Chip Day

March 17: St. Patrick's Day (Ireland's national holiday)

March 20: Spring, International Meatless Day, International Day of Happiness

March 22: World Water Day, beginning of Ramadan (until 21/04)

March 24: European artisanal ice cream day 🍦

March 25: Earth Hour, International Waffle Day, World Procrastination Day

March 27: National Cheese Day 🧀

March 29: World Piano Day

‍

April 2023

April 1: International Joke Day, April Fool's Day

April 4: International Carrot Day 🥕

April 7: World Health Day

April 10: Easter Monday 🥚

April 13: International Gastronomy Days

April 22: International Earth Day

April 27: Paris Fair

April 29: International Dance Day

April 30: International Jazz Day

‍

May 2023

May 2: World Tuna Day

May 3: World Sun Day

May 4: Star Wars Day

May 6: International No Diet Day

May 7: World Laughter Day

May 8: World Red Cross Day

May 13: International Hummus Day, World Cocktail Day 🍸

May 15: International Day of Families

May 16: The Cannes Film Festival

May 17: International Pastry Day 🍰

May 20: World Bees Day

May 21: International Tea Day 🍵

May 24: Fête de la nature, European Maritime Days 

May 25: International Geek Day

May 26: Neighbours' Day

May 28: Roland Garros begins

May 31: Europa League Final, World No Tobacco Day

‍

June 2023

June 1: World Milk Day, World Parents' Day

June 2: American National Donut Day 🍩

June 3: Nuit blanche 2023, World Cider Day

June 4: Mother's Day

June 5: World Environment Day

June 7: World Running Day

June 10: Champions League Final, World Gin Day

June 12: World Wellness Day 

June 15: World Hunger Awareness Day

June 16: National Agriculture Days, World Tapas Day

June 18: Father's Day, International Picnic Day, World Sushi Day 🍣

June 21: Summer Music Festival

June 27: World Pineapple Day 🍍

June 28: Start of the summer sales

June 30: Social Networking Day

‍

July 2023

July 1: Tour de France 2023, World Reggae Day

July 3: World No Plastic Bag Day

July 6: International Kissing Day

July 8: Summer vacation 

July 13: Japan Expo

July 14: National holiday

July 17: World Emoji Day

July 30: International Friendship Day

‍

August 2023

August 1: International French Fry Day 🍟 

August 2: National Ice Cream Sandwich Day 🍨

August 4: World Beer Day 🍻

August 12: International Youth Day

August 25: Banana Split Day

August 26: World Photography Day, International Dog Day

August 28: US Open Tennis Tournament

‍

September 2023

September 2: World Coconut Day, World Beard Day

September 8: Rugby World Cup in France

September 13: Positive Thinking Day

September 16: Oktoberfest 🍺

September 21: International Day of Peace

September 23: Autumn, Gastronomy Festival

September 27: World Tourism Day

September 29: International Food Loss and Waste Awareness Day, World Maritime Day  

‍

October 2023

October 1: International Coffee Day, International Music Day, World Chocolate Day, Grandfather's Day, World Vegetarian Day

October 4: World Vodka Day, World Animal Day

October 6: World Smile Day

October 8: World Egg Day 🥚

October 9 to 15: Taste Week

October 13: International Hamburger Day 🍔

October 16: World Food Day, Bosses' Day, World Bread Day, International Day Against Food Waste 

October 20: International Cooks Day 👩🍳

October 21: International Nacho Day

October 25: World Pasta Day 🍝

October 29: World Day of Giving

October 31: Halloween

‍

November 2023

November 1: World Vegan Day, Anti-Smoking Month, Movember

November 3: World Sandwich Day 🥪

November 7: International Merlot Day

November 11: International Singles' Day

November 13: International Day of Kindness

November 16: Beaujolais nouveau 🍷

November 17: International Students' Day

November 19: International Men's Day

November 23: Thanksgiving

November 24: Black Friday

November 27: Cyber Monday

‍

December 2023

December 1: Advent Calendar

December 5: World Soil Day

December 10: Human Rights Day

December 11: International Mountain Day

December 13: Raclette Day 🧀

December 16: International Christmas Sweater Day 

December 21: Winter

December 25: Christmas
